'''Gerr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Acolyte]] who attended the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was present in [[Harkun]]'s chamber in [[3643 BBY]] when he was called forth by the Overseer. As he complied, Harkun ordered [[Ffon Althe]] to kill him. Gerr tried to escape, but Ffon released a bolt of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and killed the acolyte.<ref name="TOR" />
